sources: Harmony archive: Sagemcom / TestBT DIW387 (codeset 22af4b4a34dfb828), a Logitech Bluetooth test device on Android TV: arrows, OK 0x41, Back 0x224, Home 0x223, Info 0x1BD, Mic 0x221, Ch 0x9C/0x9D, Record, Sleep 0x34, digits on the keyboard page
Harmony archive: NVIDIA / SHIELD TV (globalDeviceId 334356) and Google / Chromecast with Google TV: power on = Home, off = Sleep, powerOnDelay 1500 ms; their codesets are placeholders
Linux hid-input and AOSP Generic.kl key mappings, from memory and unverified: Stop, Next/Previous, Menu 0x40, Guide 0x8D
notes: Search is 0x221 (AC Search). Logitech's test device calls it Mic; it opens the Assistant on Google TV.
The Harmony Companion remote has no Home button, so the remote's Menu button goes to Home. Menu (0x40) is still a command for activities that want it.
Colour keys are left out: the Sagemcom device puts them on operator-specific F-keys.
Sleep 0x34 is used over System Power 0x30, which is untested.
verify: Sleep 0x34 puts the SHIELD to sleep, and Home wakes it
Menu 0x40, Guide 0x8D and Info 0x1BD do something useful on Google TV (low confidence)
on_delay_ms: Home to picture after overnight sleep, including the Bluetooth reconnect
